messages:
sam: noticed a p99 jump in the canary at 12:05 UTC after the batching policy change, p99 ~ 420ms -> 980ms. p95 mostly fine.
jin: saw that too. digging into the kernel selection logs — selector moved small-seq traffic to matmul_opt_v3 for the new batch heuristic. could be less stable for tail cases.
maria: the change was the adaptive_batching rollout (max_microbatch=8, prefer_dynamic=true). intended to optimize throughput. config diff: ```- batching.policy: static
+ batching.policy: adaptive
  batching.max_microbatch: 8
  batching.min_microbatch: 1
```
lucas: FYI perf profile from jenkins for a sample trace attached: "hotspot at matmul_v3_dispatch -> 15% increase in kernel latency for seq_len<=32".
sam: can we revert the policy for canary only? sounds like kernel variant is the issue, not cache miss. KV cache hitrate stable.
jin: confirm KV cache hit ratio steady at 0.92. KV latencies unchanged. tail appears correlated with increased microbatch packing leading to serialization waits + kernel warmup thrash.
maria: rolling canary back now for region us-west-2. initiating revert to batching.policy: static for canary.
deploy-bot: deploy start: revert-batching-policy canary -> rolling to us-west-2 (service: runtime-api)
lucas: adding monitoring note: watch p99 and kernel dispatch rates, also kernel-switch counts.
sam: after revert started, p99 trend flattening but still some in-flight traces. timeline: 12:06 revert, 12:09 first p99 drop, 12:12 near baseline.
jin: created a short-term mitigation: pin kernel selection threshold for small-seq to prefer matmul_opt_v2 until we add microbenchmarking. config snippet: ```kernel.selector.small_seq_threshold: 0.75
kernel.preference.small_seq: matmul_opt_v2```
maria: opening a follow-up FR to add regression test in perf CI for microbatch+small-seq combos. also we should add an experiment flag instead of full rollout.
sam: thumbs up. can we gate adaptive_batching behind rollout percentage + kernel-safety check?
lucas: yes, implement rollout_pct and kernel_safety_probe that runs microbench every deploy.
ops-bot: incident note created: INC-2026-1843 - transient p99 regression during adaptive_batching canary. status: resolved after canary revert.
maria: marking as postmortem-needed? short one focusing on rollout strategy + kernel selector integration tests.
sam: agreed — short PM with action items. :thumbsup:
